DOP: *paṭipeseti pr. 3 sg. [paṭi + peseti], sends in return; sends out, directs; — aor. 3 sg. paṭipesesi, Ja V 458, 15 (te sabbe … paṇṇāni pahiṇiṃsu, mahāsatto … paṇṇāni ~esi, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee pahiṇi); VI 334, 17 (amacco … rañño dūtaṃ pāhesi … rājā … amaccassa dūtaṃ ~esi); Sv 489, 9 (paccanto kupito ti Sumano rañño pesesi, rājā tvaṃ mayā tattha kasmā ṭhapito ti ~esi); Pj I 203, 4 (te attano janapade niyuttakapurisassa lekhaṃ pesesuṃ … so taṃ sabbaṃ sampādetvā ~esi, Se so; Be, Ce, Ee paṭinivedesi) ≠ Pv-a 20, 22 ( eds so ); 3 pl. paṭipesayiṃsu, Ja VI 411, 31 (so … sāsanaṃ pesesi, atha te … sāḷikasakuṇikā etaṃ mantaṃ jāneyyā ti ~ayiṃsu, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se paṭisāsanaṃ pesayiṃsu); — pp paṭipesita , mfn. , sent out; directed to; — ~’-atta, mfn. [paṭipesita + atta 3 ], whose being is directed to; It-a II 185, 9 (pahitatto nibbānaṃ ~’-atto ti); Th-a I 98, 27 ; II 25, 7 (nibbānaṃ ~’-attatāya); — ~-citta, mfn. [paṭipesita + citta 1 ] with thinking directed to; It-a II 174, 35 (pahitatto nibbānaṃ ~-citto ti); Th-a II 228, 33 (nibbānaṃ ~-cittatāya); Thī-a 168, 27 .

paṭipesesi.p: [Pati+pisa+ṇe+ī] (kri) CL=7 Pati+pa+isa+ṇe+ī] has been sent back. Paṭipeseti - Look.
